criteria.evidence: The doc holds only '## Directional intent' and '## Agent intent (ICE)'. There is no Benefit hypothesis, no Boundary (In / Out / Never), no Guiding rules and no Functionalities section.
criteria.fix: Add the four detailed-stage sections: a Benefit hypothesis (who it serves, what it delivers, how we will know), a Boundary with In / Out / Never each explained (name the neighbours, e.g. abandoned-carts-today and carts-won-back, and the notifications side), capability-specific Guiding rules with reasons, and a Functionalities list with one explained line each linked to its node.

criteria.evidence: "It matters because each customer who comes back and buys is a sale the owner keeps instead of losing." and "respecting their consent here is what keeps a won-back sale from costing the shop that customer's trust."

"Owning how a reminder reaches the customer means deciding which customer is reminded, when, and with what message, so that it brings them back to finish the order. The delivery channel itself (for example email) and the shared rules... come from the notifications side..." is one flowing paragraph that mixes scope, boundary and rationale.
criteria.fix: Split the intent into discrete points: separate In, Out and Never lines for what the capability owns and refuses, each with its own reason, instead of running them together in paragraphs.

criteria.evidence: The parent domain carries Guiding rules, a Capabilities list and a detailed Scope (In/Out) with reasons. This capability has only two short paragraphs and a two-line ICE, so it is thinner than its parent on consent, frequency and who may be contacted.
criteria.fix: Add detail beyond the domain: concrete rules for which customer is reminded, when, and the frequency limit; the Never line on contacting non-consenting customers; and the functionalities that carry this out.

criteria.evidence: "It will broadly own how a reminder reaches that customer and how little effort it takes the owner to send one." The limit says "never so often that it becomes spam" but gives no number or rule.
criteria.fix: After adding the missing sections, state what 'agreed to hear from the shop' means, the reminder frequency limit, what counts as one reminder, and what is out (delivery channel, consent mechanics), so a cold reader can explain what, why and edges.
